notes: SUPERSET of baseline-0.1 (all 10 entity types + all 10 predicates + all 15 aliases retained unchanged), plus a statutory/regulatory-law tier for the Tax Agent corpus. Superset because ontology_active is a single global row: activating a tax-only set would strand the msgraph-files and QBO sources on vocabulary that no longer exists. Once per-job ontology binding lands (d.s Stage 2), a leaner tax-only set becomes possible; until then this is the additive path. TIERING (naming convention only, the contract is flat by design): the 10 baseline names are the general ops tier; StatuteProvision/Regulation/AdministrativeGuidance/CourtCase/Court/LegislativeAct/DefinedTerm/Doctrine/Jurisdiction + defines/allows/disallows/limits/requires/grants_election/provides_exception_to/applies_to/interpreted_by/amended_by/effective_for/decided_by/applies_doctrine are the reusable regulatory-corpus tier (they fit any code-of-law body: Title 26, state kratom statutes for Judicial Sentinel, FOIA statutes); TaxpayerClass/TaxForm are the tax-domain tier. REUSE was preferred over invention: statute hierarchy uses part_of, operative statute-to-statute cross-references use references, and IRS/Treasury are Organization -- no duplicate vocabulary. DELIBERATELY OMITTED: a general 'TaxConcept' type (untestable boundary against DefinedTerm and Doctrine, so it would produce garbage extraction; add later if the quarantine log asks for it), and anything resembling the Tax Agent's TAX_SCHEMA determination vocabulary (expense.deductible_amount and friends) -- those are TYPED taxpayer facts from intake, not document facts, and this contract is an allowlist with no type system to validate them. IMPORTANT: statute hierarchy and cross-references are already derived deterministically by the Tax Agent's USLM XML parser for all 19,015 chunks; the part_of/references examples above tell the extractor NOT to re-derive them by reading. Feeding them in deterministically needs a seam d.s does not have yet (the prose track routes all facts through the LLM extractor).
